title: First controlled master-data write decision
purpose: Choose exactly one low-risk first Universaarl master-data record family after TARGET-035, without yet opening Preview Posting or Posting.
entryCriteria: TARGET-035 result exists and proves Customers, Vendors, Items and Locations lists read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
TARGET-035 does not prove templates, mandatory card fields or posting/VAT readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Select one first write route or explicitly block all writes with reason.
Define fields that may be changed and fields that remain untouched.
Decide whether Teaching Tips must be closed before write screenshots.
No master data, setup, draft, preview or posting is created in this decision case.

lookahead.reason: Only after TARGET-036 chooses a low-risk family and fields.
Requires real master data and accepted VAT/posting boundaries.
Page 314, VAT matrix and default dimensions remain parked and may need to be revisited before documents.

decision: First controlled Universaarl master-data write should be Location SAAR-HL, not Customer/Vendor/Item.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-035 showed Customers, Vendors, Items and Locations list surfaces read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE; no New, template, save, setup, Preview Posting or Posting occurred.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A no-write decision was still required before any first master-data record because Customer, Vendor and Item creation can involve templates and posting-related fields.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Location is useful for inventory/warehouse context and can be constrained to Code and Name.
Customer, Vendor and Item creation need template and mandatory-field discovery before any save.
Preview requires real master data plus accepted VAT/posting boundaries and expected entry trace.
Posting requires successful Preview Posting and expected ledger/subledger trace.
Page 314, VAT, inventory posting and default dimensions remain parked and should be revisited after the first safe master-data write.

queueChangesMade: Replaced broad customer-or-location follow-up with narrow Location-only gate.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It is the smallest useful Universaarl master-data write and avoids the template/accounting risk of Customer, Vendor and Item records.
risksBeforeNextCase: Locations can contain warehouse/bin fields that must not be changed in the first write.
The New action must be scoped to Locations, not a generic create flow.
No Preview Posting or Posting may be inferred from a saved Location.
requiredPreparation: Confirm playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE before clicking New.
Use screenshot QA on before/card/reopen states.
Stop if any unsafe dialog or unrelated page appears.
